meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мотреть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'watch', paired with 'посмотреть'.

examples.text: Вы сможете посмотреть на работу шефа.
examples.trans: You will be able to watch the chef's work.
